title: FTSE 100 LIVE: Stocks rise as investors find signs of stability
title_zh: 富时 100 实时指数：随着投资者发现稳定迹象，股市上涨
summary: Oil prices fell on news that Iraq has signed a deal to resume exports via Turkey
summary_zh: 伊拉克签署恢复经土耳其出口协议的消息导致油价下跌

title: Amazon, Samsung see AI driving sales, chip demand
title_zh: 亚马逊和三星认为人工智能推动销售和芯片需求
summary: STORY: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy says artificial intelligence could help cloud computing unit Amazon Web Services achieve $600 billion in annual sales.The outlook came in an internal all-hands meeting on Tuesday, with his comments reviewed by Reuters. Jassy said with wha...
summary_zh: 故事：亚马逊首席执行官安迪·贾西 (Andy Jassy) 表示，人工智能可以帮助云计算部门亚马逊网络服务 (Amazon Web Services) 实现 6000 亿美元的年销售额。这一前景是在周二的内部全体会议上提出的，路透社审阅了他的评论。贾西表示，...

title: Exclusive-Meta vowed to stop illegal financial ads in Britain. It failed 1,000 times in a week
title_zh: Exclusive-Meta 发誓要停止英国的非法金融广告。一周失败1000次
summary: U.S. tech giant Meta has repeatedly failed to stop illegal ads for high-risk financial products running on its platforms in Britain, despite committing to block them, according to a review by the country's financial regulator.
summary_zh: 根据英国金融监管机构的审查，美国科技巨头 Meta 多次未能阻止其在英国平台上运行的高风险金融产品非法广告，尽管该公司承诺阻止这些广告。

title: Microsoft considers legal action over $50 billion Amazon-OpenAI cloud deal, FT reports
title_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，微软考虑对价值 500 亿美元的亚马逊与 OpenAI 云交易采取法律行动
summary: Microsoft is considering legal action against its partner OpenAI and Amazon over a $50 billion deal that could violate its exclusive cloud ‌agreement with the ChatGPT maker, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》周三报道，微软正在考虑就一项 500 亿美元的交易对其合作伙伴 OpenAI 和亚马逊采取法律行动，该交易可能违反其与 ChatGPT 制造商的独家云协议。

title: Samsung Elec plans to produce Tesla chips starting late 2027
title_zh: 三星电子计划从 2027 年底开始生产 Tesla 芯片
summary: Samsung ‌Electronics said ‌on Wednesday that ​it expects to start volume production of ‌Tesla's ⁠chips at Samsung's factory ⁠in Texas in the ​second ​half ​of next ‌year.
summary_zh: 三星电子周三表示，预计将于明年下半年在位于德克萨斯州的三星工厂开始量产特斯拉芯片。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise with Fed decision on deck
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货因美联储决定而上涨
summary: Wall Street is preparing for the Fed's rate decision and clues to its view of  oil-driven inflation.
summary_zh: 华尔街正在为美联储的利率决定及其对石油驱动型通胀的看法提供线索。

title: Nvidia CEO Huang says company sees more than $1 trillion in sales through 2027
title_zh: Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋表示，公司预计到 2027 年销售额将超过 1 万亿美元
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang clarified comments he made during his keynote on Monday, saying that his company expects sales north of $1 trillion through 2027.
summary_zh: Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋澄清了他在周一的主题演讲中发表的言论，称该公司预计到 2027 年销售额将超过 1 万亿美元。

title: Wall Street ends higher as traders focus on Fed
title_zh: 由于交易员关注美联储，华尔街收高

title: Bitcoin shows 'resilience' amid Iran war, outshines gold and stocks
title_zh: 比特币在伊朗战争中表现出“弹性”，超越黄金和股票
summary: Strategists point to a strong buyer base as bitcoin outperforms gold and stocks amid the Middle East conflict.
summary_zh: 策略师指出，在中东冲突期间，比特币的表现优于黄金和股票，因此拥有强大的买家基础。
